want: to see all my active credit card installments in one place
soThat: I know how much I owe monthly and when each installment ends
acceptance: an Installments screen accessible from the navigation shows all active credit card installments
each installment card shows merchant name, wallet, amount per month, step progress (current/total), next due date, and estimated completion date
installments are sorted by next upcoming payment date
completed installments are shown in a separate Completed section below the active list
when a new expense transaction matches an installment by merchant and amount, the installment step count auto-increments
